summary: The Ministry of Tourism, Recreation and Culture’s mark under Bill Reid, 1986–1988: a supplied vector reconstruction from a screenshot, built on the gallery’s own flag artwork with outlined italic serif lettering. See package-README.md, Overlap_Measurements.json, reconstruction/ and review/BC_Tourism_Recreation_Culture_Overlap_Analysis.png.

assets.label: Tourism, Recreation and Culture: the flag and stripes, Hon. Bill Reid, Minister
assets.publisher: Ministry of Tourism, Recreation and Culture, Province of British Columbia
assets.sourceLocator: A screenshot of the ministry’s logo, 730 × 442 px, supplied to the project; the document it was taken from is not recorded
assets.dateNote: Its own wording dates it: “HON. BILL REID, MINISTER”. Bill Reid was Minister of Tourism, Recreation and Culture from 6 November 1986 to 6 July 1988, the whole life of the ministry of that name.
assets.notes: The flag symbol with its stripes drawn out to the left as three long bands, “Tourism” above them and “Recreation and Culture” below in italic serif, and “HON. BILL REID, MINISTER”, in one blue-violet ink.
assets.fidelityNote: A supplied vector reconstruction, not original artwork: eight paths of the gallery’s own flag (src/assets/flagMark.js, as on the Super, Natural sign) placed to the screenshot, three wave stripes redrawn as closed curves running out to the left, and the gold sun left out, as the one-ink print shows it. The lettering is outlined C059 Italic (the main line) and Liberation Serif Italic, spaced to the screenshot; the original typeface is not identified. Overlap with the screenshot: flag and stripes 95 percent, lettering 58–66 percent (intersection over union at screenshot resolution). The blue-violet #3C40A0 is estimated from the screenshot, not a colour specification.
